Repeat observed biological response at >1 post-baseline time, NOT culture duration alone; serial wound image, barrier or molecular responses.
Quantified wound/migration microscopy, morphology, histology-derived dimensions, SEM/TEM, images, automated segmentation, or fluorescence.
TEER/impedance, Lucifer yellow, FITC-dextran, quantitative chemical penetration, or barrier recovery measurement.
Gene/protein or soluble cytokine/ROS/metabolite readouts, pathway analyses, or immune-cell inflammatory phenotyping; morphology alone is insufficient.
H&E, Masson, immunostaining, lineage labels or quantitative pathology/epidermal differentiation markers.
Quantified modulus, stiffness, rheology, swelling, degradation, porosity, printer/bioink behavior, or printability.
Vessel phenotype, CD31, eNOS, angiogenesis, vascular leakage, functional perfusion, or capillary morphology.
Intervention outcome from one terminal biological measurement. Multiple culture days or multiple exposure durations are not inherently repeated measures.
Only baseline and single follow-up outcome are demonstrated.
Three or more outcome time points, without documented non-invasive same-specimen tracking of the primary experimental platform. May be cohort/animal-linked.
Serial NON-DESTRUCTIVE measurement in same experimental skin construct, monolayer or ex vivo explant (e.g. OCT/impedance/bright-field/fluorescence).
